contrast: raw first-minus-second; evaluate sealed gate direction and allowance after intervals

simultaneous_interval.draw_specific: original complete release ID; paired groups only
simultaneous_interval.full_family: paired INNER group bootstrap and three draw-index resamples per seed; max-absolute studentized critical over all 4455 clauses
simultaneous_interval.missing_source: missing P_STAR or any arm never removes a clause or changes K; affected claims incomplete
simultaneous_interval.partial_family: retain all 4455 IDs and denominator; unavailable clauses incomplete; available clauses fixed-K two-sided Bonferroni t-approximation
simultaneous_interval.reference_alias: draw0 only; exact byte-identical alias across realization IDs requires R00 predeclaration
simultaneous_interval.seed_and_grand_means: three coupled complete draw IDs sampled with replacement per seed, same draw indices across all matched arms
